Job Summary**

Operate heavy equipment safely and efficiently for the handling, loading, and unloading of feed and CKD (Clinker Kiln Dust) materials within the PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk facilities. This role ensures smooth material flow and contributes to the overall operational efficiency of the plant.

Job Responsibilities**

* Operate various types of heavy equipment, including but not limited to excavators, forklifts, loaders, and bulldozers, for material handling tasks.
* Load and unload feed ingredients, finished feed products, and CKD materials from trucks, warehouses, and storage areas.
* Transport materials to designated locations within the facility, adhering to established safety protocols and operational procedures.
* Conduct routine pre-operation and post-operation checks and maintenance on assigned heavy equipment, including fluid levels, tire pressure, and general condition.
* Identify and report any equipment malfunctions, defects, or safety hazards to supervisors promptly.
* Maintain a clean and organized work area around heavy equipment and material handling zones.
* Adhere to all company safety regulations, policies, and procedures, including wearing appropriate personal protective equipment (PPE).
* Assist with other general labor tasks as required to support plant operations.

Job Qualifications**

* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 2-3 years of experience operating heavy equipment in an industrial or manufacturing environment, preferably in feed milling or similar bulk material handling.
* Valid Heavy Equipment Operator certification/license relevant to the equipment operated (e.g., SIO for Indonesia).
* Demonstrated knowledge of heavy equipment operation, safety principles, and basic maintenance procedures.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to safety.
* Physical stamina and ability to perform duties in various weather conditions and environments.
* Willingness to work shifts, including weekends and holidays, as operational needs dictate.

Ringkasan Pekerjaan

Mengoperasikan alat berat secara aman dan efisien untuk kegiatan penanganan, pemuatan, dan pembongkaran bahan pakan serta material di area fasilitas PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk. Posisi ini bertanggung jawab memastikan kelancaran aliran material serta mendukung efisiensi operasional pabrik secara keseluruhan.

Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

• Mengoperasikan berbagai jenis alat berat, termasuk namun tidak terbatas pada forklift dan loader, untuk kegiatan penanganan material.
• Melakukan kegiatan pemuatan dan pembongkaran bahan baku pakan, produk pakan jadi, dan material dari truk, gudang, maupun area penyimpanan.
• Memindahkan dan mengangkut material ke lokasi yang telah ditentukan di dalam area fasilitas dengan mengikuti standar keselamatan dan prosedur operasional yang berlaku.
• Melakukan pemeriksaan rutin sebelum dan setelah pengoperasian serta perawatan dasar terhadap alat berat yang menjadi tanggung jawabnya, termasuk pemeriksaan level cairan, tekanan ban, dan kondisi umum alat.
• Mengidentifikasi dan segera melaporkan kepada atasan apabila terdapat kerusakan, gangguan fungsi alat, kondisi tidak normal, atau potensi bahaya keselamatan kerja.
• Menjaga kebersihan dan kerapian area kerja di sekitar alat berat serta area kegiatan penanganan material.
• Mematuhi seluruh peraturan, kebijakan, dan prosedur keselamatan kerja perusahaan, termasuk menggunakan Alat Pelindung Diri (APD) yang sesuai.
• Membantu pekerjaan umum lainnya sesuai kebutuhan untuk mendukung kelancaran operasional pabrik.

Kualifikasi

• Pendidikan minimal SMA/SMK atau sederajat.
• Memiliki pengalaman minimal 2–3 tahun sebagai operator alat berat di lingkungan industri atau manufaktur, lebih diutamakan memiliki pengalaman di industri pakan ternak (feed mill) atau pekerjaan penanganan material curah (bulk material handling) yang sejenis.
• Memiliki sertifikat/lisensi operator alat berat yang masih berlaku dan sesuai dengan jenis alat yang dioperasikan, seperti SIO (Surat Izin Operator) di Indonesia.
• Memahami pengoperasian alat berat, prinsip-prinsip keselamatan kerja, serta prosedur dasar pemeriksaan dan perawatan alat berat.
• Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun dalam tim di lingkungan kerja dengan aktivitas operasional yang tinggi.
• Memiliki ketelitian yang baik serta memiliki komitmen yang tinggi terhadap keselamatan kerja.
• Memiliki kondisi fisik yang baik dan mampu menjalankan tugas di berbagai kondisi cuaca dan lingkungan kerja.
• Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift, termasuk pada akhir pekan dan hari libur, sesuai dengan kebutuhan operasional perusahaan.

PT Ciomas Adisatwa

Job Summary

PT Japfa Comfeed Indonesia Tbk is seeking a dedicated PPL (Petugas Penyuluh Lapangan / Field Extension Officer) Broiler for the Sengkang Commercial Poultry Division (CPD). The successful candidate will act as a technical advisor and partner to our contract broiler farmers, ensuring optimal farm management, flock health, and production efficiency to meet the company's rigorous quality standards.

Job Responsibilities

* Provide technical guidance and counseling to contract farmers regarding broiler farm management, biosecurity, and feeding programs.
* Monitor and evaluate the daily growth, health, and mortality rates of the broiler flocks.
* Assist farmers in troubleshooting disease outbreaks and implementing effective biosecurity measures.
* Coordinate the distribution of production inputs (day-old chicks, feed, and medicines) and manage the harvesting process.
* Maintain accurate records of farm performance and prepare regular reports for the branch management.

Job Qualifications

* Minimum of a Bachelor’s Degree (S1) or Diploma (D3) in Animal Husbandry (Peternakan) or Veterinary Medicine (Kedokteran Hewan).
* Proven experience in broiler farm management or as a Field Extension Officer (PPL) is highly preferred; fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
* Deep knowledge of poultry health, biosecurity, and modern broiler farming systems.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills to effectively collaborate with local farmers.
* Possession of a valid driver’s license (SIM C) and willingness to be hands-on in the field and mobile across the Sengkang area.

Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.
